elements.note: Allowed inline: a (href; http, https, mailto, tel, or an internal link), strong, em, code, br. Headings rank from the base level (section#body-heading-base); a heading outside the allowed set renders as p. A body heading is never h1: at base level 1, which is a view's body or a section that draws no heading, the highest-ranked heading stored renders as h2 (base + 1). An editor stores h2 to h6 where the field allows them.

headings.children: base + 1 for the highest-ranked heading stored in the body; each other heading keeps its distance below it, at most one rank below the heading drawn before it and never below h6 (section#body-heading-base)

zeroState: Not drawn when the body has no words (an editor's empty paragraph counts as none).

notes.text: Headings inside a body are relative to the section, not the absolute levels an editor stores (h2 to h6 where the field allows them).

formerly.note: salt_sanitize_html output; allow-list p, a, strong, em, ul, ol, li, blockquote, h3, h4, br, code

owes: Wrap every body in div.salt-rich-text; map stored h2 to h6 to the base-relative levels (section#body-heading-base).
